verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI documents exporting data "in a variety of formats" and running SQL/MQL queries over tabular or binary data, writing results to a local destination path, so captured data can be pulled out programmatically. The docs never name which formats are supported or confirm they are open, and nothing covers exporting everything else or leaving the platform. Missing for 10: named open export formats, evidence the export covers all data (machine configs, datasets, trained models, fleet/org metadata), any documented account-exit or offboarding path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full export.
